document.addEventListener('click', ev => { const h2 = document.getElementById('xb-home'); if (!h2 || h2.contains(ev.target) || ev.target.closest('#top-bar,#toolbar')) return; const r = h2.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width && ev.clientX >= r.left && ev.clientX <= r.right && ev.clientY >= r.top && ev.clientY <= r.bottom) { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); h2.click(); } }, true);

document.addEventListener('pointerup', ev => { if (ev.button) return; const h2 = document.getElementById('xb-home'); if (!h2 || !ev.target || !ev.target.closest || h2.contains(ev.target) || ev.target.closest('#top-bar,#toolbar')) return; const r = h2.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width && ev.clientX >= r.left && ev.clientX <= r.right && ev.clientY >= r.top && ev.clientY <= r.bottom) { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); h2.click(); } }, true);
